title: Cross-team acceptance gate for Private Deployment PRD updates
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Summary: The Private Deployment PRD was expanded to include a new upgrade flow for air-gapped clusters and an RBAC change to support delegated admin. This ticket coordinates final sign-offs across Engineering, Design, and Legal; resolves outstanding questions; and confirms acceptance criteria for rollout to Private customers.

Scope of coordination: clarify engineering implementation constraints (migration window, downtime expectations), confirm design surface and error states for console + CLI, ensure legal review of data residency and contractual impact, and capture any additional compliance requirements for on-prem installs.
acceptance_criteria: Engineering sign-off: ENG lead confirms implementation plan and migration rollback steps (commented in ENG-2893)
Design sign-off: final mocks and microcopy approved and attached to the PRD (see link)
Legal sign-off: LEG checklist completed and LEG-74 closed or explicitly deferred with risk note
Security sign-off: security review completed for KMS/HSM integration and documented remediation items
All dependencies (ENG-2893, DES-612, LEG-74) either Done or in-blocked-state with mitigation plan
End-to-end acceptance test run in staging validating upgrade path, RBAC changes, and audit logging (pass criteria documented)
Release notes drafted and customer communication plan approved
review_steps: Share updated PRD in Confluence for targeted review (Engineering, Design, Legal) by 2025-02-14
Schedule 45-min PRD sign-off meeting with ENG/Design/Legal on 2025-02-18
Collect written sign-off comments in PRD; require explicit approval sentence and name
Resolve all blocker comments or convert to tracked follow-ups with owners and deadlines
Attach final signed PRD to release ticket and tag in release-2025.03
discussion: 2025-02-12 - Maya Chen: Created ticket after PRD update v1.3 incorporated upgrade flow and delegated admin. Tagging ENG, DES, LEG for sign-off.
2025-02-13 - Rafael Ortega: Noted two engineering open questions about KV cache migration and expected downtime. Assigned ENG-2893 to investigate and proposed staggering upgrades across nodes.
2025-02-14 - Priya Singh (Design): Shared updated console mocks in Figma and asked for microcopy guidance on failure state. Linked DES-612.
2025-02-15 - Ava Martinez (Legal): Requested data residency impact statement and customer contract language before sign-off. Created LEG-74 to track legal review.
2025-02-16 - Rafael Ortega: Engineering mitigation plan posted in ENG-2893, suggests a canary upgrade approach and automated rollback. Requested 48h cross-team review.

2025-02-18 - Sign-off meeting: Attendees Maya, Rafael, Priya, Ava, Daniel (Security). Outcome: consensus on canary approach, Design to update error microcopy, Legal to provide contract addendum by 2025-02-21.
2025-02-19 - Ava Martinez (Legal): Shared draft contract language and highlighted clause on customer opt-in for on-prem upgrade assistance. Requesting product to confirm customer-facing messaging.
2025-02-20 - Rafael Ortega: Updated PRD with engineering acceptance test plan and staging run schedule. Marking this ticket In Review while awaiting legal sign-off update.
